items.title: Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle Plus and expands access to audiobooks
items.excerpt: Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle Plus; subscribers get access to more audiobooks, including some read by AI narrators, at the same monthly price.

items.title: Library and Archives Canada cracking down on AI books amid copyright threats
items.excerpt: LAC updated its ISBN policy to limit registrations for primarily AI-generated books; registrants must now declare a human author. Canadian author groups welcomed the change.

items.title: YouTube looks to expand into audiobooks
items.excerpt: Rampant piracy on YouTube via AI-generated audio versions of books is pushing publishers to provide legitimate audiobooks on the platform. (Paywalled; lede only.)
